templates.name: Orientation: rules of engagement
templates.description: Your handler's first message. Read the MIDRASHA briefing: this is a fictional simulation and every target, group and relationship in it is invented. Write down the three rules you will work by: lawful, fictional, proportionate.

templates.name: Alphabet drill: Hebrew alef-bet
templates.description: Learn the first eleven letters of the Hebrew alphabet, their sounds and final forms. Read right to left: שלום.

templates.name: Alphabet drill: Arabic letters
templates.description: Learn eight Arabic letters in their isolated, initial, medial and final shapes. Practise reading: مرحبا.

templates.name: Alphabet drill: Farsi additions
templates.description: Farsi uses the Arabic script plus four letters: پ چ ژ گ. Learn them and read: سلام.

templates.name: Zone 2 walk: 30 minutes
templates.description: Brisk walk for 30 minutes at your target heart-rate zone. Log average heart rate and active calories.

templates.name: Bodyweight circuit: foundation
templates.description: Three rounds of squats, push-ups (knees are fine) and plank. Log reps and how you felt.

templates.name: Study: Introduction to Cybersecurity
templates.description: Work through the next module of Cisco's free introductory course. Note one new term to explain back to your handler.

templates.name: Study: Foundations of Cybersecurity
templates.description: Complete the next lesson of Google's beginner course (free to audit). Summarise it in three sentences.

templates.name: OSINT: first steps
templates.description: Read Bellingcat's beginner guide. Write three verification habits you will use on MIDRASHA's synthetic case files. Do not research real people.

templates.name: OSINT: check a synthetic press release
templates.description: A press release from the fictional Harbour Authority of Port Venn contains three inconsistencies. Find them using only the attached synthetic material.

templates.name: Survival phrases in three languages
templates.description: Greetings, thanks and introductions in Hebrew, Arabic and Farsi. Say each one aloud three times.

templates.name: Numbers, times and places
templates.description: Numbers 1-100, clock times and meeting-place words in all three languages. Then decode a short synthetic schedule.

templates.name: Code-switch briefing
templates.description: The recruiter's message switches between Hebrew, Arabic and Farsi mid-sentence. Translate it into English.

templates.name: Strength ladder
templates.description: Ladder of push-ups and squats from 1 to 8 reps and back down. Log total reps and time.

templates.name: Interval session: zones 3-4
templates.description: Warm up, then six rounds of 2 minutes hard and 2 minutes easy. Log peak and average heart rate.

templates.name: Study: networking basics
templates.description: Next module of Cisco's Networking Basics: addressing and how data moves. You will need this for the synthetic lab later.

templates.name: Ethics case study: consent and duty of care
templates.description: Read a fictional case file about a handler and a source. Mark each point where consent, honesty or the source's safety was compromised, and propose the ethical alternative.

templates.name: OSINT: geolocate a synthetic photo
templates.description: Place a generated street photo from the fictional city of Port Venn on the in-game map using signage, shadows and landmarks.

templates.name: OSINT: map a fictional network
templates.description: From synthetic posts, map how members of the invented Orchard Circle relate to each other. Record your confidence for every link.

templates.name: Scenario: the café contact
templates.description: A fictional informant, Dalia, is nervous about talking. Choose how to proceed. Choices are scored for honesty, consent and proportionality; pressure, deception or manipulation lose points.

templates.name: Decode tri-language instructions
templates.description: The recruiter's operational brief for the fictional exercise is written in all three languages. Extract the time, place and task.

templates.name: Listening brief
templates.description: Listen to a short recruiter voice message in one of your three languages and note the key facts.

templates.name: Field fitness: loaded walk
templates.description: 45-minute walk with a light backpack at your target zone. Log distance, heart rate and calories.

templates.name: Endurance test
templates.description: Hold your target heart-rate zone for 40 minutes in any activity, then do a 5-minute strength finisher.

templates.name: Write a structured analytic report
templates.description: Turn this week's synthetic case notes into a one-page report: key judgements, confidence levels, sources and gaps.

templates.name: OSINT: verify a breaking story
templates.description: A synthetic news story about a blackout in Port Venn is spreading. Check its claims against the provided synthetic sources and rate each one.

templates.name: Operation Lantern
templates.description: Integrated exercise: geolocate a synthetic photo, read a tri-language brief, check a synthetic lab network map, and decide how to handle a fictional source ethically.

templates.name: Operation Tidewater
templates.description: The invented Orchard Circle is spreading false claims about Port Venn. Map the network, verify the claims, and brief a fictional editor. A source asks for protection: your choices are scored for duty of care.

templates.name: Final assessment
templates.description: Day 90. One integrated fictional scenario across every pillar, then a debrief with your handler on what you would do differently, and why.
